entities.summary: Berthe Hoola van Nooten was a Dutch botanical artist, noted for her botanical plates illustrating "Fleurs, Fruits et Feuillages Choisis de l'Ile de Java" in 1863–64. Hoola van Nooten is denoted by the author abbreviation Hoola van Nooten when citing a botanical name.
